Delta stated that safety is paramount and apologized to customers for the experience.

title: Bank of America Is Near a Record High. Is It Still Worth Buying?
summary: Bank of America (BAC) is trading near a record high following a strong quarter driven by impressive trading revenue and investment banking fees. Other firms like UBS and Barclays remain positive, but the consensus indicates the stock is no longer deeply mispriced, raising questions about future upside for new buyers.

title: Microchip Technology (NASDAQ:MCHP) Posts Quarterly Earnings Results, Beats Estimates By $0.06 EPS
summary: Microchip Technology (NASDAQ:MCHP) reported strong quarterly earnings, beating analyst estimates with an EPS of $0.76 against a $0.70 consensus and revenue of $1.48 billion, exceeding expectations by $20 million. title: Why Revolution Medicines (RVMD) Is Up 9.4% After Mounting Losses And Surging Daraxonrasib Demand – And What's Next
summary: Revolution Medicines (RVMD) is experiencing a 9.4% stock increase despite mounting losses, driven by the advancement of its drug daraxonrasib through FDA review for metastatic pancreatic cancer. The drug has seen significant demand, with over 2,000 patients receiving it through compassionate use even before potential approval. The company faces ongoing high cash burn and losses but has a strong cash balance and positive Phase 3 data for daraxonrasib, which analysts project could lead to substantial revenue and earnings by 2029.

title: LegalZoom (LZ) Integrates Microsoft Copilot Amid Growth Shifts
summary: LegalZoom (LZ) has integrated its services into Microsoft 365 Copilot, aiming to offer business formation, compliance, and attorney consultations directly within the productivity tool. Investors are now weighing the potential of the new Copilot integration and consistent subscription revenue growth against the challenges posed by reduced online visibility and a cautious outlook on customer acquisition.

title: This Supremely Popular Condiment Brand Is Owned By The Clorox Company
summary: Clorox, widely known for household cleaning products, has owned the popular condiment brand Hidden Valley Ranch since 1972. Hidden Valley Ranch is now a staple in many households and fast-food chains, representing a significant portion of the over $1.3 billion ranch industry.

title: This Supremely Popular Condiment Brand Is Owned By The Clorox Company
summary: The Clorox Company, known for household cleaning products, has owned Hidden Valley Ranch since 1972, transforming it from a mail-order seasoning packet to a national condiment brand. title: Herb Simon sues family of late nephew David over dissolution of real estate interest
summary: Herb Simon, co-founder of Simon Property Group, is suing the family of his late nephew, David Simon, over the dissolution of a 31-year-old real estate offshoot named SFG Co. LLC. The lawsuit alleges that SFG Co.'s managers dissolved the business to benefit David Simon's family, keeping other equity holders in the dark, and removed preferred distribution rights. David Simon's son, Eli, who is now CEO of the relevant entities, has called the lawsuit "meritless."

title: TransUnion Warns Lenders on Private Student Loan Risk After US Rules

TransUnion emphasizes the critical need for sound underwriting practices given the high federal student loan delinquency rate, suggesting that private lenders must distinguish between short-term and persistent repayment difficulties through alternative data and longitudinal credit views.

title: Electronic Arts (NASDAQ:EA) sells for $210, handing over $505 million yearly coupon hurdle to acquirers
summary: Electronic Arts (NASDAQ:EA) has been acquired for $210 per share, totaling approximately $55 billion, by a consortium led by PIF, Silver Lake, and Affinity Partners.
